title: Data Scientist
description: Synthetic role: partner with a product team to design experiments, analyze customer behavior and communicate uncertainty. Own reproducible Python and SQL analyses, not only dashboards. Expected experience: at least 3 years of relevant applied analysis.
screening_criteria: Build reproducible data analysis in Python.
Write SQL joins, aggregations and analytical queries.
Design and interpret controlled experiments with statistical uncertainty.
At least 3 years of relevant applied analysis experience.

questions.text: Walk through an experiment you designed. How did you define success and handle uncertainty?
Describe a Python and SQL analysis you owned and how you checked its correctness.
What was your personal contribution, and how long did you work in applied analysis?

requirements.description: Build reproducible data analysis in Python.
Write SQL joins, aggregations and analytical queries.
Design and interpret controlled experiments with statistical uncertainty.
At least 3 years of relevant applied analysis experience.
Experience with dbt or reproducible warehouse transformations.
A quantitative degree or equivalent documented applied study.
